target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite/out_large
echo "### C: mean |W| vs window length L at s=0 (residue Weyl sum, additive k=1, Q=27) ###"
awk -F, '!/^#/ && $1!="seed" && $5=="add" && $6==1 && $7=="0.0000" && $4==27 {n[$3]++; s[$3]+=$10}
  END{printf "%6s %8s %10s\n","L","nwin","mean|W|"; for(L in s) printf "%6d %8d %10.4f\n",L,n[L],s[L]/n[L]}' defect_windows.csv | sort -n -k1
echo "### C: mean |W| by tilt at fixed L=32, Q=27 k=1 ###"
awk -F, '!/^#/ && $1!="seed" && $5=="add" && $6==1 && $4==27 && $3==32 {n[$7]++; s[$7]+=$10}
  END{for(t in s) printf "  s=%s  mean|W|=%.4f (n=%d)\n",t,s[t]/n[t],n[t]}' defect_windows.csv | sort
echo "### G: trace/det sanity (Q=27, s=0, trivial) ###"
awk -F, '!/^#/ && $1==27 && $3=="0.0000" && $4==0 && $5>=1 && $5<=4{printf "  tr(L^%s)=%.4f\n",$5,$6}' trace_determinant.csv
echo "### sizes ###"; du -sh . ; echo "congruence rows:"; grep -vc '^#' congruence_checks.csv
